card.name: Modern Dance
card.tagline: Early 20th-century America — Isadora Duncan kicked off her shoes and rewrote what bodies could say.
card.profile: Modern dance is a broad genre of western concert or theatrical dance which includes dance styles such as ballet, folk, ethnic, religious, and social dancing; and primarily arose out of Europe and the United States in the late 19th and early 20th centuries. It was considered to have been developed as a rejection of, or rebellion against, classical ballet, and also a way to express social concerns like socioeconomic and cultural factors.
card.insight: Isadora Duncan died in 1927 when her long scarf got tangled in the wheel of a Bugatti convertible.
